title: Configurable Request Logging Middleware with Log Rotation
description: Adds a built‑in request logger that captures method, URL, status, response time and optional request body. Logs are written to a rotating file (daily) and can be disabled or customized via framework config, improving observability and troubleshooting in production.
testCases: Should log a formatted line for each incoming request with correct method, URL, status and response time
Should rotate log files daily and create a new file when the date changes
Should respect configuration flags to disable logging or change log level
Should handle errors in the logging stream without crashing the server
acceptance: When the middleware is enabled, every request generates a log entry in the configured log file, the file rotates at midnight, and any logging errors are caught and reported without affecting request processing. All test cases pass and existing test suite remains green.
reason: Observability is essential for production services; a zero‑dependency, configurable logger gives developers immediate insight into traffic patterns and errors, reducing mean‑time‑to‑detect and -resolve issues without adding external dependencies.
